notice_and_patent_findings: OpenCV complete recursive tree has no standalone NOTICE or PATENTS; doc/LICENSE_CHANGE_NOTICE.txt is retained.
ADE complete tree has LICENSE and no NOTICE/PATENTS. KleidiCV complete 26.03 tree has Apache-2.0 and no NOTICE/PATENTS; per-file Arm copyright notices are retained.

The vendored libwebp sources explicitly reference PATENTS/AUTHORS absent from the OpenCV subtree. Full official WebM PATENTS and AUTHORS are included; key source files and COPYING match v1.6.0 byte for byte.
libjpeg-turbo LICENSE.md and complete README.ijg are retained, with the exact Independent JPEG Group acknowledgment separately included.

Berkeley qsort four-clause notice found inside datastructs.cpp is retained in full, with the acknowledgment included. The FreeBSD-hosted Berkeley rescission is recorded as historical evidence only; no clause is silently deleted and no legal conclusion is made.
SIFT original patent notice and upstream expiry statement are retained verbatim. This audit is not an independent patent search or freedom-to-operate opinion.

Ficus AUTHORS/LICENSE and Kaldi COPYING close explicit source references; their pre-OpenCV-release upstream snapshots are pinned. These snapshots corroborate the declared license, not an exact historical origin hash of each modified borrowed algorithm.

Intel ITT BSD alternative, quirc ISC and OpenCL header license are precautionary and not represented as linked implementations. Trace built-in means HAVE_ITT is false in the official build-summary generator.

remaining_release_gates.required_evidence: After integration, build the intended configuration and verify the exact OPENCV_NOTICES.txt and MODEL_NOTICES.txt bytes are included in the delivered app. The new notice resource has not been native-built or signed/distributed by this audit.

Review the retained notices and chosen distribution materials, including the IJG and Berkeley acknowledgments and any advertising implications; do not infer legal clearance from automated coverage or rescission evidence.

remaining_release_gates.gate: Binary source identity / final link boundary
remaining_release_gates.required_evidence: The official binary identifies version 4.14.0 and matching dependencies but is not independently reproduced bit-for-bit. A future final-app link map may narrow the conservative inventory; this audit does not silently remove notices based on presumed dead stripping.

YuNet/SFace declared model licenses and LFS digests are verified separately. Training-data, biometrics, consent, privacy and child reliability remain separate decisions; no weight/photo redistribution occurred.
Unsigned generic-device CI success is not signed-device recognition, consent persistence, reliable identity discrimination or safe-use validation.
